diagnosis.testedChange: Historical V3 versus opt-in V4 guarded proposal grammar under unchanged V3 quality admission, with one shared live initial source and honestly labeled existing E3 replays.
conclusions: All four shared first attempts were live E4; one failed source syntax before application. Three were graded: one fully accepted, one public/hidden-case functional failure, and one functionally correct but quality-rejected.

Six of eight declared arm stages executed from three exact shared sources; two remained unexecuted after the syntax-rejected initial source. Both arms retained the same already accepted common success. Neither produced a fully accepted live repair.

One functional repair in each arm passed all twelve private cases but violated unchanged complexity, nesting and declaration limits. Another quality repair in each arm broke a previously correct candidate: private cases dropped from 12/12 to 7/12 in V3 and 4/12 in V4, and public examples failed.

Zero guarded proposal prompts and zero resolved selections. Three executed pairs matched measured repair compute, but none qualifies as a causal V4 gain. The mechanisms cannot be promoted from this epoch.

All eight unique model calls delivered with complete reported usage, zero provider failures, zero retries, and zero observed truncations. The syntax failure is not a provider failure or a graded reasoning failure. Later valid but wrong candidates are functional failures.
The frozen pair field providerStable is false for the unexecuted syntax pair because complete arm comparison is unavailable; this does not establish unstable provider delivery.
Independent authored E3 witnesses demonstrate feasible solutions under the unchanged V3 quality oracle. These are not live model solutions and are never fed to initial generation.

The exact token causing the syntax rejection and exact missing guarded source construct are unknown because raw source was deliberately not retained. Final-line syntax rejection with finish=stop is not proof of transport truncation.
diagnosis.nextGeneralInvestigation: Reproduce behavior-destroying structural quality repair on separate development domains, then test a narrowly source-anchored/general semantics-preserving repair mechanism on fresh tasks with simpler controls, unchanged oracles and matched realized compute. Do not relax thresholds, solve vector-clock examples directly, reconstruct raw model reasoning, rerun this frozen epoch for promotion or expand cognitive layers.
